result.title: Non-Linear Motion from Two Frames: Cubic Hermite Trajectories for Video Frame Interpolation
result.summary: Two-frame video frame interpolation commonly resamples endpoint optical flow by the query time, which selects a constant-velocity straight-line path even though the same endpoint displacement is compatible with many intermediate trajectories. We present HermiteVFI, which replaces independent query-time motion prediction with one explicit continuous trajectory per pixel. The measured endpoint displacement fixes the two trajectory positions, while two latent endpoint derivatives learned from the frame pair control the interior path. A cubic Hermite curve is the minimum-degree polynomial that can independently satisfy these two position and two derivative boundary quantities. Its residual form contains linear motion exactly, structurally preserves the measured displacement endpoints for any network output, and has coefficients that are predicted once per frame pair and evaluated in closed form at arbitrary t. We further show that one interior query time gives a rank-deficient constraint on the two free trajectory coefficients, whereas any two distinct interior times are full rank at the representation level, motivating multi-time supervision. Appearance-derived directional cues help infer the latent derivatives that endpoint displacement alone cannot identify. On X4K1000FPS, SNU-FILM, and Vimeo90K-Septuplet, the largest gains occur for difficult non-uniform motion and high interpolation ratios. The amortization applies to trajectory-coefficient prediction; downstream reversal, refinement, and synthesis remain query dependent.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 HermiteVFI：不再按查询时间重采样端点光流，而是为每个像素构造一条三次 Hermite 连续轨迹，用端点位移固定两端位置、由帧对学习两个 latent 端点导数控制内部路径，轨迹系数每帧对只预测一次并可对任意 t 闭式求值，并分析单时刻监督秩亏、两个不同内部时刻满秩，据此引入多时刻监督。
AI.relevance_reason: 「一次预测、任意 t 求值」的 latent 轨迹参数化与多时刻监督可辨识性分析，可能可供核查 LVR 中状态生成方式与训练监督时间点密度、贡献分配的关系；但论文属视频插值，不直接研究多模态推理。
